principle: Gender presentation adjusts the center of pitch and resonance without changing intelligence, authority, age, emotional range, or racial identity.

presentations.name: Male
presentations.guidance: Use a generally lower pitch center and fuller lower resonance while preserving natural variation.
presentations.guardrail: Do not force an unnaturally deep voice or treat depth as authority.

presentations.name: Female
presentations.guidance: Use a generally higher pitch center and lighter resonance while preserving weight and natural variation.
presentations.guardrail: Do not make the voice childlike, breathy by default, or less authoritative.
